title: Mnyambuliko wa Vitenzi (Theme 11: Haki za watoto)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child forms kutendeka (-eka/-ika: can be done), kutendewa (-ewa/-iwa: done for) and kutendatenda (stem repeated: done again and again).
steps: Can be done, done for, or again and again?
Add the ending or repeat the stem.

board.say: Anaruka mara moja au mara nyingi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "anarukaruka" and one -ika form.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kitenzi kipi kiko katika kauli ya kutendeka?" Kwa nini "pikiwa" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Ni kitenzi kipi kiko katika kauli ya kutendewa?" Kwa nini "pikika" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Pigapiga humaanisha nini?" Kwa nini "kupiga mara moja" si jibu sahihi?
Ni sehemu gani ya kitenzi inarudiwa?
